title: If you use Homebrew every day and hate how slow it feels, check out ZeroBrew  #github

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: If you use Homebrew everyday and hate how slow it feels, check out ZeroBrew. It's an open-source Rust replacement for Homebrew that's way faster, five times faster on first installs, and up to 20 times faster on repeats. It uses a content addressable cache and parallel downloads, and pulls from the same homebrew bottles you already use. The best part, it's drop-in compatible. You can try it without wrecking your current brew setup.
